No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Congratulatory Message To Senator Abdulaziz Yari On His Investiture As Madugun Kasar Hausa by LEADERSHIP News 17 seconds ago in Branded Content Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The Renewed Hope Network (TRN) warmly extends its heartfelt congratulations to its leader and the Director General of the President Bala Ahmed Tinubu’s 2027 re-election Campaign, Distinguished Senator Abdulaziz Yari on his prestigious conferment as (MADUGUN ƘASAR HAUSA) by the revered Daura Emirate under the leadership of His Royal Highness Alhaji Umar Farooq Umar.
Madugun Kasar Hausa (the trusted commander) pioneer and visionary leader of the caravan, is a profound testament to your courage, wisdom and exceptional leadership.
To be trusted with the title of Madugun Kasar Hausa (The Vanguard and Guide of Hausaland) from the historic cradle of Hausa civilization, Daura, is an honour of paramount distinction
It symbolizes your role as a trusted beacon, bridging tradition with modern governance and guiding your people toward unity, strength and progress.
May Almighty Allah (SWT,) adorn this exalted office with abundant wisdom, honour, and dignity.
May He grant you sound health, steadfast courage, honor, and dignity. May your elevation bring enduring peace, unity and prosperity across Hausaland and the entire nation. Ameen..
